subtopics.title: Evaluate All System Components
subtopics.summary: Assessing every part of an AI application, not just the model, to ensure each component functions correctly within the system.

subtopics.title: Create Evaluation Guidelines
subtopics.summary: Defining scoring rubrics with examples and tying evaluation criteria to business metrics to standardize assessment.

subtopics.title: Define Evaluation Methods and Data
subtopics.summary: Selecting appropriate evaluation methods, annotating data, and determining the necessary volume of examples for reliable results.

subtopics.title: Evaluate and Iterate the Pipeline
subtopics.summary: Assessing the evaluation pipeline itself for cost, latency, and metric correlation, then iterating based on findings.
